en.headline: Development chief says Queen Mary lift shafts have dimensional deviations
en.dek: Secretary Ning Hoi-tak said installation workmanship, damaged components and shaft wall size errors are being fixed, with rectification expected in the fourth quarter and costs borne by the contractors.
body: Development Bureau Secretary Ning Hoi-tak said on Tuesday that problems with lifts at Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical block include installation workmanship issues, damaged components and dimensional deviations in the lift-shaft outer walls that left insufficient clearance for smooth operation.

Speaking after a forum, Ning said the issues are now under control and the government is confident rectification can be completed within the fourth quarter so that all lifts meet safety requirements. She stressed that the full cost of remedial works will be met by the main contractor and subcontractors, with no additional public expenditure, and that the government retains the right to claim under the contracts.

Ning declined to give further technical detail at this stage to avoid prejudicing possible claims. The bureau has asked the Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department to submit reports for internal review of supervision and acceptance arrangements. Clinical services have yet to move fully into the block while the lifts remain under repair.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：瑪麗醫院𨋢槽外牆尺寸有偏差 料第四季完成執修
zh.dek: 發展局局長表示升降機問題涉及安裝工藝、部件破損及井道外牆尺寸偏差，當局有信心今年第四季完成執修，費用由承建商支付。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪今日回應瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機故障事件，指問題涉及升降機部件安裝工藝欠妥、部分部件破損，以及井道（𨋢槽）外牆結構尺寸出現偏差，導致中間虛位不足，升降機運行不暢順。
甯漢豪表示，有關問題已在掌握之中，當局正陸續解決工程欠妥之處，有信心今年第四季內完成執修，確保所有升降機符合安全要求。她強調整修費用必定由總承建商及分判商支付，不會增加公帑開支，政府並會按合約保留索償權利。
她指現階段不宜鉅細無遺交代技術細節，以免影響索償及引起法律爭拗。發展局已要求建築署及機電工程署提交報告，自我檢視監督及驗收安排。新大樓臨床服務仍未全面遷入。
